description: Save context information to the cache so you can recall it later without re-computing. Perfect for caching: codebase overviews, file summaries, project structure, frequently-accessed data, or "thinking" results like dependency analysis. The AI assistant can use this to avoid re-reading the entire codebase every time. Overwrites any existing value stored under the same key. Returns { key, stored_at, ttl } confirming the saved context. Example: remember_context("project overview", "This is a Next.js app with...") then later: recall_context("project overview"). Use recall_context to retrieve; use list_remembered to see all stored keys.

ttl.description: Time-to-live in seconds (default: 86400 = 24h, use 0 for no expiry)

name: remember_context
